summary: `committed`'s shipped hover says false means a clean exit or no-op, while `commitSha` beside it names a real tip contribution on the same footprint-only wave

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: the two hovers the package's own `.d.ts` carries for `TickResult` agree about a fanout wave that shipped nothing and recorded a merge-failure footprint: `committed` states the ship it actually answers rather than "a clean exit or no-op", so a chain author reading the pair is not told the tick did nothing while `commitSha` beside it names the commit that wave put on trunk
pins: a fanout wave that shipped nothing and recorded a footprint reports committed false and names the ledger commit it landed
notes: Verified: `waveCommitted` (`src/waveMerge.ts:985`) is `w.shipped.length > 0`, reported at `src/waveTick.ts:683`, while `:689` sets `commitSha`/`ledgerCommitShas` off `ledgerShas`, appended at `src/waveMerge.ts:1064` for the footprint-only rewrite (`src/pendingLedger.ts:681`). `tests/Dispatcher.test.ts:4395` is that wave — no ship, footprint commit on trunk. `src/Phase.ts:335` is the hover, `:336`-`:350` its neighbour. `harness/handoff.ts:278` reads the pair.
